corrections.ruling: A. An interface lead that says 'the oasis' as its source does keeps the bare «نخلستان» on two conditions. (1) The same sentence names «الاحساء». (2) N47-the-oasis-on-a-page-that-has-not-named-it is met on the page, in its own words: «الاحساء کے نخلستان» / «الاحساء کا نخلستان» stands in at least one field of the rendered page, including one behind a tap (a closed group, a collapsed card). On this index that field is the bird-garden card «الاحساء کے نخلستان کے ماحول میں ایک باغ،». It sits in the farms group, which is closed when the page opens, and it counts. Condition (1) never stands in for (2). B (the oasis named in the lead, 'Al-Ahsa' at the close becoming 'here') is not needed here.
corrections.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read. A lead with the bare «نخلستان» names «الاحساء» in the same sentence, AND N47 holds for the page: at least one field of the rendered page, including one behind a tap, names «الاحساء کے نخلستان» / «الاحساء کا نخلستان». What is visible at first view is not the test. If no field of the rendered page names it, the lead takes B's form.

corrections.ruling: A. N5's qualifier «زرعی» is owed where «فارم» stands UNQUALIFIED as a label or a list item, as in nav.leisure «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم», where two readers read the bare word as the form one fills in. It is not owed where a possessive or an attribute already qualifies the word, because that context fixes the sense. Here «فارموں» is qualified by «نخلستان کے» («نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں»), so the bare oblique stands. This is the ground of the approved texts too: «زکی السالم کا فارم», «اسٹرابیری کا فارم», and «… کاشت کرنے والے سب سے بڑے فارموں» on zaki-alsalem-farm. The kind of string (lead, meta description, heading) does not decide it. A string ruled a meta description under N184 is not, by that alone, owed the qualifier. This agrees with N5 and changes none of its forms.
corrections.guard: For the proofreader: «زرعی» before «فارم» where the word stands unqualified as a label or a list item (N5: nav.leisure, the farm-group label «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات»). It is not required where a possessive or an attribute qualifies it («… کا فارم», «نخلستان کے … فارموں», «… والے … فارموں»). A bare «فارم» as a label or list item is a finding; a qualified one is not.
